subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Produzir textos diversos sobre fatos, acontecimentos e personalidades do passado (linha do tempo/ timelines, biografias, verbetes de enciclopédias, blogues, entre outros).

components.description_pt: Identificar características principais de textos sobre eventos passados e figuras históricas (linhas do tempo, biografias, entradas enciclopédicas, blogs)
components.description_en: Identify key features of texts about past events and historical figures (timelines, biographies, encyclopedia entries, blogs)
components.cc_component_description: Identify the interactions among key individuals, events, and ideas within an informational text

components.description_pt: Usar formas verbais no passado para narrar eventos e descrever figuras históricas na escrita
components.description_en: Use past tense verb forms to narrate events and describe historical figures in writing
components.cc_component_description: Form the simple past tense of regular and irregular verbs correctly

components.description_pt: Produzir um texto escrito estruturado sobre um evento passado ou figura histórica em gênero apropriado
components.description_en: Produce a structured written text about a past event or historical figure in an appropriate genre
components.cc_component_description: Narrate a historical event, scientific procedure, or technical process in a structured explanatory text

components.description_pt: Selecionar uma estrutura organizacional apropriada à tarefa, propósito e público
components.description_en: Select an organizational structure appropriate to the task, purpose, and audience
components.cc_component_description: Select an organizational structure appropriate to the task, purpose, and audience

cc_matches.description: Produce clear and coherent writing in which the development, organization, and style are appropriate to task, purpose, and audience.
Analyze the interactions between individuals, events, and ideas in a text (e.g., how ideas influence individuals or events, or how individuals influence ideas or events).
Form and use the simple (e.g., I walked; I walk; I will walk) verb tenses.
Write informative/explanatory texts, including the narration of historical events, scientific procedures/experiments, or technical processes.
